neighbours.label: Fires on the token 'Go'/'go' when it is the first piece of a longer word or name (Goethe, Goths, gothic, GoPro, go-kart) or an imperative link 'Go here'; much weaker on the ordinary verb 'go' and quiet on other G-words.
fire: Many students read Goethe in their second year of German.
The family started a GoFundMe page to pay the hospital bills.
Our church still keeps its gothic arches and stained glass.
He bought a used go-kart and fixed the engine himself.
Every surfer on the beach seemed to wear a GoPro on a strap.
The poet admired Goethe more than any other writer of his age.
Rome was sacked by the Goths in the fifth century.
She loves gothic novels full of ruined abbeys and storms.
quiet: Many students want to go abroad in their second year of German.
The family started a fundraising page to pay the hospital bills.
Our church still keeps its rounded arches and stained glass.
He bought a used bicycle and fixed the gears himself.
Every surfer on the beach seemed to wear a camera on a strap.
The poet admired Gogol more than any other writer of his age.
Rome was sacked by the Vandals in the fifth century.
She loves to go hiking in ruined abbeys during storms.

notes: Probes (fraction of max 282): Goethe 0.87, gothic 0.78, Goths 0.74, GoPro 0.68, go-kart 0.66, 'Go here' 0.65; verb 'go to the beach' 0.19; Gobi (split ' G'+'obi') 0.02. Fire items use words that split as ' Go'/' go' + rest (checked with the tokenizer).
